## Description {#details}

This header defines the <code>test&#95;suite&#95;base</code> and <code>test&#95;suite</code> classes, which provide the mechanisms for grouping and executing related test cases within the µTest++ framework.

The <code>test&#95;suite&#95;base</code> class supplies the foundational interface for managing test suite state, including counters for successful and failed checks, test case tracking, and methods for marking the commencement and completion of test cases and suites.

The <code>test&#95;suite</code> class extends this functionality, enabling the registration and execution of callable objects (such as lambdas or function pointers) as test suites. Test suites automatically register themselves with the test runner upon construction, thereby facilitating automated test discovery and execution.

All definitions reside within the <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link></code> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.

This file is intended for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
